authority: synthetic benchmark only; tests whether a matched endogenous adaptive system exhibits a descriptive predictive-resource difference from an exogenously nonstationary control under one fixed predictor family

predictor.family: multi-output ridge over fixed polynomial interaction features

primary_readout.distortion: normalized mean squared error on structurally held-out reversed intervention orderings
primary_readout.representation_cost: number of stored scalar initial-state features
primary_readout.compute_proxy: predictor feature dimension multiplied by output dimension

primary_contrast: A_minus_N_structural_nmse at matched representation and training sample count

decision_rule.A_not_harder_than_N: A_minus_N_structural_nmse <= 0 at the full_state representation and maximum training sample count
decision_rule.descriptive_A_excess: A_minus_N_structural_nmse > 0 at the full_state representation and maximum training sample count
decision_rule.interpretation: Either outcome is descriptive synthetic evidence only; no intrinsic frontier, scaling law, adaptive-quality claim, or new construct is authorized.

scope.omega: order reversal only; no scalar intervention-complexity construct

systems.N: theta changes via known exogenous time schedule independent of intervention identity
systems.A: theta changes as a function of intervention descriptor
